lore.way: the steaming pass where the ash of The Cinder Coast runs into the snow of The Frostfen

sign.cinder_coast: Snow is falling on hot ash: the whole camp hisses with steam, and the imps hate it.
sign.frostfen: The meres of The Frostfen are thawing at their edges, warmed from The Cinder Coast.

lore.way: the old burial road from The Cinder Coast to the mounds of The Barrow

sign.cinder_coast: Bones have been washing up in the ash, burnt black, from the direction of The Barrow.
sign.barrow: The graves smell of smoke: something from The Cinder Coast has been digging.

lore.way: a long smoking ravine that climbs from The Mirewood up to The Ember Caldera

sign.mirewood: Smoke from The Ember Caldera settles on the bog, and the water runs warm and sour.
sign.ember_caldera: Steam from The Mirewood's bog curls up the ravine and dies on the lava.

lore.way: a tunnel of black glass that runs down under The Barrow into The Ember Caldera

sign.barrow: The graves of The Barrow are warm to the touch: the fire of The Ember Caldera runs under them.
sign.ember_caldera: Grave-dust from The Barrow drifts down the glass tunnel and burns in the heat.

long_thaw.title: The Long Thaw

chapters.title: Where Two Lands Meet
intro: You came at a strange time.
I am {keeper}. Something has gone wrong between {r1} and {r2}, and I mean to know what.
You came at a strange time.
I am {keeper}. The fire of {r1} is eating into the ice of {r2}, and the ice is fighting back.
You came at a strange time.
I am {keeper}. The cold of {r2} is reaching into {r1}, and it should not reach this far.

chapters.title: The Heart of the Cold
intro: Whatever drives the cold lives deep in {r2}.

quests.learned: The {r1.common.lower} are restless because the land under them is changing.
fieldNote: The last one flees, slipping on ground that is half ice and half mud.
quests.title: Steady the Camp
offer: The {r1.common.lower} are half mad with the change in the air. Drive off five before they hurt someone.

quests.learned: The {r2.site.lower} are where the cold of {r2} comes from.
fieldNote: Three of them, and each one colder than the last.
quests.title: Touch the Cold
offer: Go into {r2} and lay your hand on three of the {r2.site.lower}. Tell me how cold they are.
done: Colder than ice has any right to be.

fieldNote: Three of them, sweating in the warm wind from {r1}, and refreezing as you watch.
variants.learned: The {r2.site.lower} are fighting the heat from {r1}: something wants {r2} to stay frozen.
done: They are fighting the thaw. Something in {r2} wants the cold to win.

fieldNote: Three of them, and the frost around each one is spreading toward {r1}.
variants.learned: The {r2.site.lower} are pushing the cold outward, toward {r1}.
done: They are spreading. If nothing stops them, {r1} will freeze solid by midwinter.

quests.learned: The {r2.brute.lower} guard the deep cold; they were sent, not born there.
fieldNote: The third one falls into the snow and does not get up.
quests.title: Break the Guard
offer: The way to the heart of {r2} is guarded. Break three of the {r2.brute.lower}.
done: Then only the heart is left.

quests.learned: The {r2.boss} carried the cold in its body; with it gone, the land can find its balance.
fieldNote: The {r2.boss} falls with a sound like a frozen lake breaking. The wind changes.
quests.title: The Heart of the Cold
offer: The cold has a heart, and it walks. The {r2.boss}. End it.
done: I felt it from here. The air is softer already.
Take this: it was waiting for someone like you.
Fire and frost will settle now, the way they should: a little of each, and neither winning.
Take this: it was waiting for someone like you.
The frost is drawing back from {r1}. The bog will be a bog again by spring.
Take this: it was waiting for someone like you.

epilogue: {r1} and {r2} meet the way they always did: an uneasy border, but a quiet one.
Stay a while. There is always more to mend.
